Nadia, Gideon landed on 280 seats for Vantorre Group. I replied in the #strategic-pod thread with the same answer.

His July 1 update first said 300. A few minutes later he corrected it, because the 300 included sandbox logins from their May rollout. The 280 is the active production roster as of July 1, and Ruth confirmed it in the channel.

That figure is from July 1, so it isn't a current count.
